Name: Joash, Son of Ahaziah
Summary: Son of Ahaziah in the kingly line of Judah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:11: Son of Ahaziah in the kingly line of Judah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joash stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
